message_images_blocked: Remote images blocked ({count}) to protect your privacy.
help_palette_hint: Every command is also available from the palette:
remove_explanation_after: will be removed from Norelly: its password is erased from the keyring and its local data is deleted. Messages stay on the server.
add_password_hint: The password is kept in the system keyring, never in Norelly's files.
add_confirm_warning: was found through DNS ({source}) outside your address's domain. A forged DNS answer could send your password to a third party.
add_confirm_checkbox: I confirm that {host} is a server of my provider
add_cert_changed: this server presents a certificate different from the one you had accepted. This may indicate that the connection is being intercepted.
add_cert_acknowledge: I have checked with the administrator that this new certificate is legitimate
add_cert_trust_advice: Only trust this server if you know it uses this certificate (personal server, company network) and the fingerprint matches the one given by its administrator.
add_plain_warning: The connection to {host}:{port} would not be encrypted: your password and messages would travel in clear text and could be read or modified on the network.
add_plain_starttls: If the server offers it, Norelly will still switch to TLS (STARTTLS).
add_secrets_warning_before: No system keyring (GNOME Keyring, KWallet…) is responding. Norelly can store your passwords in an
add_secrets_warning_after: file, readable only by your user account: anyone with access to your files will be able to read them.
add_issue_unknown_issuer: The certificate is not signed by a recognised authority (self-signed certificate?).
add_issue_not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet.
add_issue_hostname_mismatch: The certificate does not match the server name.
add_msg_dns_outside: Server found through DNS outside your address's domain: {hosts}. Check that it really belongs to your provider before continuing.
add_msg_incomplete: Not all servers could be found automatically: check or complete the settings.
add_msg_confirm_first: First confirm server {hosts}, or replace it.
add_msg_cancelled: Connection cancelled. You can edit the settings.
add_msg_already_exists: An account already exists for this address.
add_msg_must_confirm: Server {host} must be confirmed before connecting.
add_fail_authentication: {prefix}credentials rejected. Check the username and password (an app password is sometimes required).
add_fail_network: {prefix}server unreachable. Check the name and port.
